items.title: MDIA: A Multi-Agent Diagnostic Intelligence Pipeline on HealthBench Professional
items.title_zh: MDIA：基于 HealthBench Professional 的多智能体诊断智能流水线
items.summary: MDIA is a seven-node specialty-routed clinical reasoning graph built on a non-fine-tuned LLM that scores 0.6272 on the full HealthBench Professional benchmark under GPT-5.4, 3.72 percentage points above ChatGPT for Clinicians. The authors attribute the lift to specialty routing, multi-turn context preservation, drug-state safety gating, site-filtered search and length-aware synthesis, and note that grader choice changes the score.

items.title: Learning to Reason Efficiently with A* Post-Training
items.title_zh: 用 A* 后训练学习高效推理
items.summary: The authors frame natural-language deduction as search for a valid proof and train models with supervised fine-tuning on A* execution traces or reinforcement learning with A*-informed process reward models. Llama-3.2 models in the 1B-3B range go from near-zero accuracy to outperforming DeepSeek-V3.2, with A*-informed signals trading some accuracy for efficiency.

items.title: OpenAI Privacy Filter: A Cross-Lingual, Cross-Domain PII Evaluation Across 32 Benchmarks
items.title_zh: OpenAI Privacy Filter：跨语言、跨领域的 PII 评估覆盖 32 个基准
items.summary: The paper evaluates OpenAI's 1.5B-parameter Privacy Filter across 32 benchmarks in 14 languages and five domains, finding zero-shot F1 of 0.855 on AI4Privacy and 0.464 on the SPY medical benchmark but sharp degradation outside its PII training distribution. Fine-tuned XLM-RoBERTa surpasses it with roughly 500 labeled English examples, and performance collapses for non-Latin scripts.

items.title: Benchmarking the Personalization Capabilities of Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 大语言模型个性化能力基准评测
items.summary: The authors introduce SDR-Arena and SDR-Bench, a corpus of 50,000 customer success stories across 22 industries and 3,500 enterprises, to test two-party personalization where an agent reconstructs the arguments that won a deal. The best model, Claude Sonnet 4.6, reaches 55.8% weighted nugget recall, and an ablation shows the bottleneck is retrieval rather than reasoning.

items.title: CP-Agent: A Calibrated Risk-Controlled Agent for Feedback-Driven Competitive Programming
items.title_zh: CP-Agent：面向反馈驱动竞赛编程的校准风险受控智能体
items.summary: CP-Agent models feedback-driven competitive programming as a calibrated stopped process and instantiates dual-granularity verification, test augmentation and experience-driven self-evolution. Without updating model parameters it raises Pass@1 from 25.8% to 48.5% on LiveCodeBench Pro and improves Refine@5 by 11.0% on ICPC-Eval across three backbones.

items.title: The Open Source Economic Index of AI Adoption and Capability
items.title_zh: AI 采用与能力的开源经济指数
items.summary: The authors build an open-source economic index from public user-LLM chat data and O*NET tasks, finding the highest adoption in finance, computer science and arts occupations. They also generate O*NET- and MCP-grounded benchmark scenarios and find that Kimi-k2.5 with an OpenAI agents SDK harness executes high-level workflows but often errs on granular tool calls.

items.title: PRIMA: Operational Patterns for Resilient Multi-Agent Research with Verifiable Identity and Convergent Feedback
items.title_zh: PRIMA：具备可验证身份与收敛反馈的弹性多智能体研究运行模式
items.summary: PRIMA presents three operational patterns for multi-hour multi-agent research runs: a resilience layer that persists typed pause records and resumes without redoing converged work, a sub-agent discipline for task fidelity and tool use, and a multi-phase drafting pattern with cross-document harmonization. Agent identities derive from prime powers, giving collision-free identifiers and O(k) verification.

items.title: RAGe: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Evaluation Framework
items.title_zh: RAGe：检索增强生成评估框架
items.summary: RAGe is a modular framework for benchmarking RAG applications that correlates retrieval and generation quality with hardware constraints while recommending pipeline components for a domain-specific dataset. It evaluates document chunking, vector databases, embedding models and retrievers across accuracy, efficiency and scalability trade-offs, including on consumer-grade hardware.

items.title: bryanyzhu/agentic-ai-system-course
items.title_zh: agentic-ai-system-course：用智能体来学智能体的骨架课程
items.summary: This JavaScript GitHub course had 669 stars and 95 forks and teaches how to design, build and operate production AI agents, framed as using agents to learn about agents.

items.title: ongridio/ongrid
items.title_zh: ongrid：能定位并修复基础设施故障的运维 AI Agent
items.summary: ongrid is a Go-based ops AI agent with 1,223 stars and 272 forks that understands infrastructure, finds root causes and fixes them from Slack, Telegram, Lark or DingTalk.

items.title: termio-sh/termio
items.title_zh: termio：终端优先的智能体开发环境
items.summary: termio is a Swift project with 584 stars and 44 forks offering a terminal-first agentic development environment for CLI and TUI coding agents, pitched as a runtime and a tmux alternative for coding agents.
